# Skill Creator aggregation fixture

Unmodified `aggregate_benchmark.py` from Anthropic's official Skill Creator plugin, installed revision `85cce0381e78`, under the included Apache 2.0 license. SHA-256: `123ef128ea5ccc01a4b1ac212ef5567f21e9c13d3d240609780beeb3200c49aa`.

The strict packer is tested against this real upstream aggregation implementation without depending on an operator's plugin installation or network access. `AGGREGATE_SCRIPT` can select another installed version explicitly for diagnostic compatibility checks. This fixture is test input; production still requires an explicit aggregation script and digest.
